visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a 'Ghost in the Shell' graphic, sits on a white couch reading a manga book. A circular inset displays a grayscale illustration of an elderly manga character with long white hair. The background is a clean, minimalist indoor setting with soft, natural lighting. (2) The man looks directly into the lens, holding the book slightly open, then gestures towards his smartphone while smiling. He wears a small green microphone clipped to his shirt. The camera is steady at eye-level. (3) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white and pink floral dress, sits in a studio setting behind a traditional wooden Go board (Goban) with black and white stone containers. She looks at the camera and demonstrates a Go move. (4) The screen transitions to a screen recording of a digital Go app interface. A hand is seen tapping the screen to place black stones on a grid. Numerical and star-shaped markers appear on the board, followed by green checkmark overlays indicating success in a puzzle. (5) The man reappears, holding his phone vertically, looking intensely at the screen with a focused facial expression. He then reacts with a pained, dramatic face as if he lost a game. (6) A promotional graphic fills the screen featuring a large portrait of the woman on the left and bold yellow and white text announcing a 'Yearly Anniversary Sale' (週年慶) with a 70% discount (七折) and specific dates.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male creator (shasha77), 1 female Go teacher (Joanne Missingham).
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The male character has styled brown hair and a white graphic tee. The female character has long dark hair and a modest floral print dress.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A minimalist white indoor living room with a sofa, and a professional studio set with a traditional Go board and stone bowls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with traditional Japanese-style strings and a deep male voice speaking Japanese in a dramatic, narrative tone. A low-frequency percussive hit marks a transition. (2) A sharp digital 'ding' sound effects occurs, and the music shifts to a high-tempo electronic beat with a synthesized bassline. A energetic young male voice begins speaking Mandarin rapidly. (3) A soft digital 'pop' occurs as the male speaker pauses, followed by a calm, professional female Mandarin voice explaining Go concepts. The BGM remains a steady background pulse. (4) Multiple bright, high-pitched UI sound effects (dings and trills) occur in quick succession, synchronized with the successful placement of stones in the app demo. (5) A 'whoosh' transition leads back to the male speaker, who uses a high-pitched, exaggerated comic voice to express frustration ('Ke-ke-ke-e'), followed by a rapid sales pitch over a swelling electronic synthesizer track with a strong 4/4 drum machine beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Challenge -> Solution/Product Demo -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the 'Hei Jia Jia Go' (HJJ GO) app. It uses a comedic hook regarding the traditional view that Go requires two players, then counters it by demonstrating how the app allows for solo practice and learning with AI and teacher modules. The video concludes with a direct call to action regarding an anniversary discount.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the HJJ GO app features, presence of the founder/teacher Hei Jia Jia, and a dedicated sales promotion screen at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production social media ad utilizing fast cuts and trendy editing to appeal to a younger demographic interested in learning traditional Go.
